title: Coordinate Basis Linear Bandits with Sublinear Regret over Low-Rank Clusters
abstract: arXiv:2611.25424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the problem of computational efficiency for linear bandits in high-dimensional settings with a finite arm set. In linear bandits, the increase in the dimension $d$ of the feature vectors leads to growing computational costs of $O(d^2)$ at each round of update. Traditional low-rank approximation methods such as SOFUL reduce computation via fixed-size matrix sketching, yet run the risk of incurring vacuous linear regret when the spectral tail of the data is heavy and the approximation rank is inadequately selected. To guarantee regret convergence and effectively reduce computational costs, we introduce a clustering mechanism and propose the Coordinate Basis Linear Bandit (CBL) algorithm. Our method preserves the full covariance information in each cluster by maintaining an exact orthonormal basis of the cluster's column space together with a low-dimensional coordinate representation, which guarantees robust sublinear regret withou

translated_title: 基于低秩聚类的坐标基线性老虎机算法及其次线性遗憾保证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25424v1 公告类型：new 摘要：我们研究了在动作集有限的高维环境下线性老虎机算法的计算效率问题。在线性老虎机中，特征向量维度 $d$ 的增加会导致每一轮更新的计算成本增长至 $O(d^2)$。传统的低秩近似方法（如 SOFUL）通过固定尺寸的矩阵草图技术来降低计算量，但当数据谱尾部较重且近似秩选择不当时，这类方法存在产生无效线性遗憾的风险。为了保证遗憾收敛并有效降低计算成本，我们引入了一种聚类机制，并提出了坐标基线性老虎机算法。我们的方法通过维护每个聚类列空间的精确正交基以及低维坐标表示，保留了每个聚类内的完整协方差信息，从而保证了鲁棒的次线性遗憾……
tldr: 该论文提出坐标基线性老虎机算法，通过聚类机制在每个聚类中维护精确正交基和低维坐标表示以保留完整协方差信息，在高维线性老虎机场景中同时实现了计算效率提升与鲁棒的次线性遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Coordinate Basis Linear Bandit (CBL) algorithm, which preserves full covariance information within each cluster by maintaining an exact orthonormal basis and low-dimensional coordinate representation, achieving computational efficiency with robust sublinear regret guarantees in high-dimensional linear bandits.
